summary: Record bounded resource history and sustained memory pressure in the node monitor
details: An independent resource worker records host RAM, swap, CPU/I/O pressure and cgroup v2 container usage, limits, cache, swap and memory-event deltas while service probes run separately.

History includes release/session/boot/container identity, resource configuration, timestamped service progress, existing probe durations and controller resource transition boundaries. Probe instrumentation does not introduce new RPC requests.

Local monitor resources queries export raw samples, minute summaries or transitions with time/session/service filters and pagination. Default retention is 7 days raw and 30 days summarized within a separate 256 MiB history budget; early capacity eviction and collection/storage failures are visible.

Sustained memory-pressure alerts require pressure evidence, preserve unknown observations and use the existing notification lifecycle without automatically changing budgets or restarting services. The handbook explains diagnosis and metric limits.
operator_actions: Activate the updated node kit through the normal upgrade procedure and start its monitor with up. Check monitor status and monitor resources; past measurements are not backfilled.
Fine-grained container measurements require readable Linux cgroup v2 counters. Unsupported or unreadable fields remain explicitly unavailable.
